page.intro_en: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has published the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates for document verification and online scrutiny form filling for the Driver Recruitment 2024. The online portal for submitting the scrutiny form remains open from 30 October 2026 to 12 November 2026. Applicants must check their status and complete the formalities within the stipulated timeframe.
